subject: Clarification on per-token tiers, model surcharges, and commit-split options
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@nimbushealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question on pricing tiers and model surcharges

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers look great. Before we move to an internal approval, our procurement and engineering leads asked for a clearer breakdown of how hosted usage discounts and commit tiers work across different model classes. A few specific asks:

- We expect ~250M generated tokens/month and ~25M tokens-equivalent for embeddings (roughly 10%). What are example monthly costs under: no commit, a 250M token commit, and a 500M token commit?
- Do you treat embeddings as a separate pricing unit or as token-equivalent? If separate, how do commit discounts apply?
- Some of our workflows need "premium" models (higher quality). Do premium models carry a surcharge or a separate SKU? Any reduced surcharges for longer commitments?
- Can a committed tier be allocated across different model SKUs (e.g., 50% premium chat, 50% standard chat + embeddings), or does it need to be per model?

If you can send an example quote or a short spreadsheet with sample math that we can share with procurement, that would help. Our goal is to get finance comfortable so we can escalate to legal.

Regards,
Sarah
Sarah Liu
Head of Platform Integrations
Nimbus Health

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2026 18:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question on pricing tiers and model surcharges

Hi Sarah — great questions. I put together a short summary and attached a commit-tier grid (see commit-tier-grid.xlsx). High level:

- Pricing primitives:
  • Standard chat: $0.0008 / output token (example, billed per token)
  • Premium chat (Redwood-Premium-X): +40% surcharge over standard (so example $0.00112 / token)
  • Embeddings: billed per 1,000 vectors-equivalent — example $0.005 per 1,000 (we can also express as token-equivalent on request)

- Commit tiers (hosted usage, applied monthly):
  • No commit: list rates (above)
  • 250M token commit: 12% discount off list for total token spend
  • 500M token commit: 20% discount off list for total token spend
  • Discounts apply to token-based generation/chat consumption only; embeddings get a separate commit bucket or can be included in a blended commit if customer prefers (we show both options in the spreadsheet).

- Premium model handling:
  • Premium models are priced as a multiplier (surcharge) above the standard model. For multi-month commitments we can reduce the premium surcharge (e.g., 40% -> 30%) at 12-month term + 500M commit — this is negotiable.

- Commit split and flexibility:
  • Commits can be applied as a blended pool across SKUs; customers can elect to have a dedicated embeddings bucket instead. We track per-SKU consumption and apply discounts to the blended spend each month unless you opt for dedicated buckets.

Next steps: I can produce a worked example with your 250M/25M split and show final monthly cost under no-commit / 250M commit / 500M commit. Attaching the grid for visibility.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: commit-tier-grid.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick question on pricing tiers and model surcharges

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Sarah's email and my initial reply. They gave a rough usage profile (250M tokens gen / 25M embeddings). I'm proposing the standard grid below; want your opinion on tightening the incentive so we don't under-index on premium-model usage.

Quoted:
> From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@nimbushealth.com>
> Date: Tue, 18 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
> Subject: Quick question on pricing tiers and model surcharges
>
> (see original above)

My proposed terms to offer as a first pass (internal):
- 250M commit: 14% discount (we currently showed 12%) if they sign a 12-month term (gives us visibility and reduces churn risk)
- Premium surcharge: reduce to 30% for any premium model if the commit is >= 250M and term is 12 months
- Include embeddings in blended pool by default, but add explicit reporting and an option to carve-out a dedicated embeddings bucket (no extra discount applied to carved-out bucket)

Any objections? If you're comfortable I can send the updated grid and a short note asking procurement if they prefer blended vs carve-out.

— Laura

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 10:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick question on pricing tiers and model surcharges

Thanks for the ping — sounds reasonable. A couple of suggestions from GTM:

- Make the 500M tier: 22% -> 25% discount at 500M if they commit to a 12-month annual term. We want to show a clear step-up to encourage a larger commit.
- Premium surcharge: agree on 30% for 12-months. If they commit to auto-renew and 24-months, we can go to 20%.
- Add a short SLA/uptime clause and a one-time onboarding credit ($10k) to sweeten the initial PO — makes procurement easier.

I'll approve sending the updated grid and a one-page summary (discount_offer_v1.pdf). Happy for Laura to send to Sarah once you update numbers.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: discount_offer_v1.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@nimbushealth.com>, Nimbus Health Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: blended commit options + premium-model surcharge reduction

Hi Sarah — thanks for the patience. Attached is a short summary (nimbus_commit_summary_v2.pdf) and an updated grid showing blended vs carve-out treatment. Key points: 

- For your profile (250M gen / 25M embeddings):
  • No commit: ~$210k/month (estimate)
  • 250M commit (12-mo): ~13% blended discount -> ~$182k/month
  • 500M commit (12-mo): 25% blended discount (per Marissa) -> ~$157k/month
- Premium-model surcharge: 30% with a 12-month commitment; 20% with a 24-month auto-renew
- Embeddings: included in blended pool by default. If you prefer a carve-out bucket we can show final quote both ways (same grid).

Next steps: if this looks good I can:
1) Create a HubSpot proposal and push a DocuSign package (link below).
2) Add the one-time onboarding credit and SLA language to the SOW.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/D-83421
DocuSign (proposal): https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC123DEF

Would you prefer blended or carve-out for embeddings? If blended, I’ll send the DocuSign and attach the full SOW with SLA.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: nimbus_commit_summary_v2.pdf
